candidates.description: This feature vector represents pharmacological substances, medications, and drug dosages.
This vector represents medical conditions, physical symptoms, and bodily afflictions.
This vector represents actions or processes involving change, fluctuation, or modification in scale, quantity, or condition.
This vector represents comparative adverbs and adjectives expressing degree, scale, or manner.
This vector represents the concept of generation, creation, and supply of goods or materials.
This feature vector represents the concept of administering or introducing a substance into the body, particularly via medical or pharmacological methods.
These tokens represent adverbs and verbs expressing frequency, likelihood, or typical behavior.
This vector represents the concept of legality, compliance with rules, and authorization.
This feature represents quantifying adjectives and pronouns indicating plurality, variety, or undetermined quantity.
This vector represents the concept of reliance, contingency, or being determined by external factors.
